Spider-Man: Homecoming

Tom Holland's debut solo outing hid huge Marvel lore in plain sight. From comic nods to future villain setups, here are the best details you missed.

📅 2017-07-05 ★ 7.3 ⏱ 133m

COMIC TIES

The Miles Morales Clue

Donald Glover plays Aaron Davis, known in Marvel comics as the Prowler. When Davis mentions having a nephew in Queens, he confirms Miles Morales exists in the MCU.
Close ⚡ MoviePulse
VILLAIN REVEAL

Scorpion Strikes

Michael Mando portrays criminal Mac Gargan on the ferry. The scorpion tattoo on his neck and the prison credits scene explicitly tease his comic alter ego.

INSIDER TRIVIA

Damage Control Origins

The Department of Damage Control dates back to 1989 Marvel comics. Tony Stark taking over cleanup operations directly provoked Adrian Toomes to turn into the Vulture.

FAN THEORIES

Cap's Rogue Status

Captain America's gym class PSA videos were outdated relics. His appearance reminded classmates of the Sokovia Accords fallout while Steve Rogers was officially an MCU fugitive.
